reading.title: Pluto Direct Under Libran Sun
overview: The Sun at 21° Libra in fall forms a tight sextile to Jupiter in Leo, while Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde sextiles Pluto at 3° Aquarius retrograde as the latter stations direct out of bounds. The Moon at 8° Sagittarius out of bounds moves toward a trine with Mars in Leo and Saturn in Aries retrograde, with Mars itself trining Saturn. These contacts occur against a backdrop of Venus in Scorpio retrograde squaring Pluto and Mars.

Mundane tradition associates a Sun-Jupiter sextile with measured diplomatic or institutional gestures and a Neptune-Pluto sextile with slow, collective shifts in belief or power structures. Mars trine Saturn points to protracted attrition and defensive consolidation rather than rapid gains, while Pluto's station directs attention to long-term structural changes that surface after periods of reversal.

The last new moon at Libra 17° falls in the 11th whole-sign house for the United States and the 6th for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran, placing emphasis on alliances and legislative matters for Washington and on armed forces or public services for the others. No positions are invented; all statements rest on the listed placements and aspects.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC while Saturn trines the ASC and the Sun trines natal Mars. These contacts coincide with reporting on Army training programs and Starlink limitations in Ukraine support, though the records show no reliable link between such transits and operational outcomes beyond chance.

Neptune squares the 1991 Sun and Jupiter trines the MC while Uranus trines natal Saturn. Reporting on drone strikes and energy infrastructure pressure aligns with the Mars-Saturn trine theme of sustained pressure, yet the fair test finds Mars afflictions no better than chance for personnel-loss indicators.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Saturn squares natal Uranus. The lunation in the 6th house and Mars in the 4th echo themes of armed forces and homeland defense present in today's strike reports, without any demonstrated predictive edge over random expectation.

Pluto conjoins both the Moon and ASC while Neptune sextiles the Moon. The new moon in the 4th house places focus on land and internal matters, separate from the day's listed reporting on other regions.

reading.lore_and_intel: Sun sextile Jupiter overlaps with Vatican health news and Army pay statements; Neptune sextile Pluto with incident reporting and cybersecurity analysis; Mars trine Saturn with Middle East strike speculation and drone marketplace expansion. Venus square Pluto meets labor-automation stories. These are noted overlaps only; the fair test records show Mars afflictions and lunar phases perform no better than chance against Ukraine air-raid, Israeli alert, Russian loss and global earthquake data.

reading.the_test: Mars afflicted brings war versus Ukraine air-raid alarms a day: no better than chance over 1663 days. Mars afflicted brings war versus Russian personnel losses a day: no better than chance over 1662 days. Eclipses and new or full moons bring earthquakes versus magnitude 6+ events worldwide: no better than chance over 9750 days.
